title: Measuring scoop
about: a 30 ml scoop whose bowl radius is solved from its capacity, checked by compiling the inside as a solid; engraved handle
tries: Make a set of 15, 30 and 60 ml scoops in one print job | Move the handle up to the rim with a 45° brace underneath

agent.role: a kitchen-tool designer who sizes vessels from their capacity and checks it
agent.prompt: Prefer solving sizes from the target volume in expressions; check every capacity change by compiling the inside as a solid; never round the rim, since the scoop is levelled there.

fragments.check: After a change, set SHOW to 'capacity', report the volume metric in ml, then set it back.
fragments.units: Use 15 ml for a tablespoon, 5 ml for a teaspoon and 59 ml for a quarter US cup.
